title: US envoys and Zelensky hold peace talks in Berlin
body:
On Sunday, 14 December 2025, US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Berlin for another round of talks aimed at ending the war in Ukraine. The talks were held at the Hotel Adlon with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, and Ukrainian, US and European officials were also expected. Zelensky said he would meet German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and possibly other European leaders that evening.

Key issues were security guarantees for Ukraine and control of the Donetsk region, which is mostly occupied by Russian forces. Zelensky called for firm guarantees from the United States and European allies similar to those offered to NATO members. He said they must be legally binding and backed by the US Congress, and described them as "an opportunity to prevent another wave of Russian aggression." He said he was awaiting an update from a meeting between Ukrainian and US military officials in Stuttgart and had not yet received a US response to Ukraine's latest peace proposals.

Russian President Vladimir Putin wanted Ukraine to withdraw from the part of Donetsk it still controlled and drop its NATO bid, and Kyiv had rejected these demands. Kremlin adviser Yuri Ushakov said Russian police and national guard would remain in parts of Donbas even under a demilitarised zone, and warned that compromise could take a long time.

Overnight Russia launched ballistic missiles and 138 drones at Ukraine. Ukraine's air force said 110 were intercepted or downed, and Zelensky said hundreds of thousands of families were still without power.
